---
title: "Agentic Revenue Analysis"
subtitle: "OBO revenue targets (accounts with an agentic PoV): consumption, adoption, ARR and target forecast"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  snapshot: ''
  # The cohort is every account with op_list$accounts$OBO_revenue_TGT = TRUE (an
  # agentic PoV on report 00OVV000007QLj72AG), and each target lands in the fiscal
  # quarter of its PoV's Expected End Date. This hand-maintained list (Account Name,
  # POC Completion Estimate, FY28-Q1 style) fills in a quarter where a PoV has no
  # expected end date, and is the cohort for snapshots built before OBO_revenue_TGT.
  poc_file: data/input/obo_pocs.csv
  # Right-sizing rule for the contract-rework scenario: seats = registered users x this.
  seat_buffer: 1.25
  # Price per OBO session (USD). 0 = not set yet: the report shows the revenue
  # OBO sessions must cover, but not a session count.
  obo_price: 0
  # Consumption below this ratio is "low" (same threshold as low_consumption).
  low_threshold: 0.25
  # Session-based expansion target as a share of ARR, added to every account's OBO
  # revenue target on top of rework and open agentic pipeline. 0 = targets are the
  # rework gap + pipeline only (healthy and ELA accounts then show what's in pipeline).
  expansion_pct: 0
---

<!-- Question (from "Agentic Revenue Analysis", Google Doc): customers with low
     consumption will be harder to drive agentic expansion with; we will likely
     have to rework contracts, reduce user counts and add OBO sessions, which is
     how we charge for agentic data access. This report looks at the active OBO
     POCs by consumption, adoption rating and ARR, then sizes the rework. -->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Knit from reports/; everything below runs from the project root.
root <- normalizePath("..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

usd  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", scales::dollar(round(x)))
usdk <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—",
                    ifelse(abs(x) >= 1e6, paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 2), "M"),
                           paste0("$", round(x / 1e3), "K")))
pct  <- function(x, d = 0) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%"))
int  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))
num  <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
key  <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

# FY28-Q1 (how the POC list is written) <-> Q1-2028 (date_to_fiscal_quarter()).
fq_std  <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  ifelse(grepl("^FY\\d{2}-Q[1-4]$", x), sub("^FY(\\d{2})-Q([1-4])$", "Q\\2-20\\1", x), x)
}
fq_show <- function(q) ifelse(is.na(q), "—", sub("^Q([1-4])-20(\\d{2})$", "FY\\2-Q\\1", q))
fq_rank <- function(q) as.integer(sub("^Q[1-4]-", "", q)) * 4 + as.integer(sub("^Q([1-4]).*$", "\\1", q))

rating_colour <- function(x) {
  x <- key(x)
  out <- ifelse(grepl("^(green|amber|yellow|red|black)", x), sub("^(green|amber|yellow|red|black).*$", "\\1", x), NA)
  ifelse(out == "yellow", "amber", out)
}
COL <- c(green = "#16A34A", amber = "#F59E0B", red = "#DC2626", black = "#111111")

# "A", "A and B", "A, B and C".
and_list <- function(x) if (length(x) <= 1) paste(x) else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
# Seats used. ELAs (0 licensed = unlimited seats) count as 100% consumption
# (consumption_ratio()): company strategy is to drive session-based expansion there.
seats_used <- function(ratio, licensed, d = 1) pct(ratio, d)
```

```{r data}
# ── op_list: the snapshot named in params, else the newest one ──────────────
snap <- if (nzchar(params$snapshot)) file.path(root, params$snapshot) else {
  f <- list.files(file.path(root, "data"), pattern = "^opportunities_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.RData$",
                  full.names = TRUE)
  f[order(f, decreasing = TRUE)][1]
}
load(snap)   # -> op_list
snap_date <- sub("^opportunities_(.*)\\.RData$", "\\1", basename(snap))
this_q    <- date_to_fiscal_quarter(as.Date(snap_date))

# ── Every account: ARR, adoption, consumption ──────────────────────────────
acc <- op_list$accounts
col_or_na <- function(df, nm) if (nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
book <- data.frame(
  account   = acc$`Account Name`,
  arr       = num(acc$`Contract ARR Rollup`),
  csm       = col_or_na(acc, "Customer Success Manager"),
  rating    = col_or_na(acc, "product_adoption_rating"),
  score     = num(col_or_na(acc, "product_adoption")),
  lifecycle = col_or_na(acc, "Lifecycle Stage"),
  agentic   = col_or_na(acc, "Agentic Governance Adoption"),
  months    = num(col_or_na(acc, "months_as_customer")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
book$colour <- rating_colour(book$rating)

lc <- op_list$consumption$low_consumption
m  <- match(key(book$account), key(lc$`Account Name`))
lcv <- function(nm) if (!is.null(lc) && nm %in% names(lc)) num(lc[[nm]])[m] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(book))
book$registered <- lcv("Registered Users")
book$licensed   <- lcv("Licensed Users")
book$active31   <- lcv("[Usage Metrics] Users with Native Platform Query (Last 31 Days)")
# Query volume on Production instances (Looker look 1745, low_consumption$query_volume):
# with licensed users, the proxy for OBO session volume. NA on snapshots built before it.
book$query_volume <- lcv("query_volume")
book$ratio      <- consumption_ratio(book$registered, book$licensed)   # ELA (0 licensed) -> 1
book$band       <- cut(book$ratio, c(-Inf, params$low_threshold, 0.75, Inf), right = FALSE,
                       labels = c(paste0("Low (<", pct(params$low_threshold), ")"),
                                  paste0("Moderate (", pct(params$low_threshold), "–75%)"), "High (≥75%)"))

# ── OBO usage (Looker obo_sessions: one row per instance) ──────────────────
ob <- op_list$consumption$obo_sessions
obo <- if (is.data.frame(ob) && nrow(ob)) {
  acol <- if ("...1" %in% names(ob)) "...1" else names(ob)[1]
  data.frame(k = key(ob[[acol]]), agents = num(col_or_na(ob, "enabledAgentUsers")),
             roles = num(col_or_na(ob, "totalVendedRoles"))) %>%
    group_by(k) %>% summarise(agents = sum(agents, na.rm = TRUE), roles = sum(roles, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
} else data.frame(k = character(0), agents = numeric(0), roles = numeric(0))
book$obo_agents <- obo$agents[match(key(book$account), obo$k)]
book$obo_roles  <- obo$roles[match(key(book$account), obo$k)]

# ── Agentic profile (one row per account, same rollup as the dashboard tab) ─
ap <- tryCatch(.ao_build(op_list$agentic_profile, op_list = op_list, exclude_risk = character(0))$data,
               error = function(e) NULL)
apv <- function(nm) if (is.null(ap)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(book)) else
  ap[[nm]][match(key(book$account), key(ifelse(is.na(ap$account), ap$name, ap$account)))]
book$conv   <- apv("status")
book$eval   <- apv("eval")
book$deploy <- apv("deploy")
book$next_steps <- apv("next_steps")

# ── Next renewal per account ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ren <- op_list$renewals
ren$end <- as.Date(ren$`Current Contract End Date`)
next_ren <- ren %>% filter(!is.na(end)) %>% group_by(k = key(`Account Name`)) %>%
  filter(end == min(end)) %>%
  summarise(renewal_end = min(end), renewal_amt = sum(num(Amount), na.rm = TRUE),
            renewal_risk = paste(unique(`Account Risk`), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
book$renewal_end  <- next_ren$renewal_end[match(key(book$account), next_ren$k)]
book$renewal_amt  <- next_ren$renewal_amt[match(key(book$account), next_ren$k)]
book$renewal_risk <- next_ren$renewal_risk[match(key(book$account), next_ren$k)]
book$renewal_q    <- ifelse(is.na(book$renewal_end), NA, date_to_fiscal_quarter(book$renewal_end))

# Open agentic expansions (opportunity name mentions agentic / OBO).
ex <- op_list$expansions
agx_exp <- ex %>% filter(grepl("agentic|\\bobo\\b|on.behalf", `Opportunity Name`, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(k = key(`Account Name`)) %>%
  summarise(agentic_pipeline = sum(num(Amount), na.rm = TRUE), agentic_opps = n(), .groups = "drop")
book$agentic_pipeline <- agx_exp$agentic_pipeline[match(key(book$account), agx_exp$k)]

# ── The cohort: every OBO revenue target account ──────────────────────────
# accounts$OBO_revenue_TGT (TRUE = a project on the agentic PoV report). Older
# snapshots without it fall back to the hand-maintained list in params$poc_file.
pov <- op_list$agentic_pov
pocs <- if (nzchar(params$poc_file) && file.exists(file.path(root, params$poc_file))) {
  read.csv(file.path(root, params$poc_file), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else data.frame(`Account Name` = character(0), `POC Completion Estimate` = character(0), check.names = FALSE)
csv_q <- setNames(fq_std(pocs$`POC Completion Estimate`), key(pocs$`Account Name`))

has_tgt <- "OBO_revenue_TGT" %in% names(acc) && any(!is.na(acc$OBO_revenue_TGT))
if (has_tgt) {
  tgt_names  <- acc$`Account Name`[!is.na(acc$OBO_revenue_TGT) & acc$OBO_revenue_TGT]
  cohort_src <- "op_list$accounts$OBO_revenue_TGT (agentic PoV report 00OVV000007QLj72AG)"
  unmatched  <- if (is.data.frame(pov)) unique(pov$pov_account[!pov$matched]) else character(0)
} else {
  tgt_names  <- pocs$`Account Name`
  cohort_src <- paste0(params$poc_file, " (this snapshot predates OBO_revenue_TGT)")
  unmatched  <- pocs$`Account Name`[!key(pocs$`Account Name`) %in% key(book$account)]
}

# PoV completion: the earliest Expected End Date across the account's projects.
pov_acc <- if (is.data.frame(pov) && nrow(pov) && any(pov$matched)) {
  pov[pov$matched, , drop = FALSE] %>% mutate(end = as.Date(expected_end)) %>%
    group_by(k = key(account)) %>%
    summarise(poc_end = if (all(is.na(end))) as.Date(NA) else min(end, na.rm = TRUE),
              pov_status = paste(unique(stats::na.omit(status)), collapse = ", "),
              pov_projects = n(), .groups = "drop")
} else data.frame(k = character(0), poc_end = as.Date(character(0)), pov_status = character(0), pov_projects = integer(0))

poc <- book[key(book$account) %in% key(tgt_names), ]
pi_ <- match(key(poc$account), pov_acc$k)
poc$poc_end    <- pov_acc$poc_end[pi_]
poc$pov_status <- pov_acc$pov_status[pi_]
csvq           <- unname(csv_q[key(poc$account)])
poc$poc_q      <- ifelse(!is.na(poc$poc_end), date_to_fiscal_quarter(poc$poc_end), csvq)
poc$poc_q_src  <- ifelse(!is.na(poc$poc_end), "PoV expected end date",
                  ifelse(!is.na(csvq), "Estimate (obo_pocs.csv)", "No completion date"))
book$is_poc <- key(book$account) %in% key(poc$account)

# ── Contract rework scenario ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Price per seat = ARR / licensed seats (blended: it also carries platform fees).
# Right-size to registered users x seat_buffer (never above today's seats), and
# the ARR those seats no longer carry is what OBO sessions must make up to keep
# the account flat.
poc$ela          <- !is.na(poc$licensed) & poc$licensed == 0
poc$price_seat   <- ifelse(poc$ela | is.na(poc$licensed), NA, poc$arr / poc$licensed)
poc$unused       <- pmax(0, poc$licensed - poc$registered)
poc$right_seats  <- ifelse(poc$ela, NA, pmin(poc$licensed, ceiling(pmax(poc$registered, 1) * params$seat_buffer)))
poc$seat_arr     <- ifelse(poc$ela, poc$arr, poc$right_seats * poc$price_seat)   # ELA = 100% consumed: nothing to rework
poc$obo_needed   <- pmax(0, poc$arr - poc$seat_arr)
poc$sessions     <- if (params$obo_price > 0) poc$obo_needed / params$obo_price else NA
poc$low          <- !is.na(poc$ratio) & poc$ratio < params$low_threshold
poc$timing <- with(poc, ifelse(is.na(poc_q), "No PoV completion date", ifelse(is.na(renewal_q), "No open renewal",
  ifelse(fq_rank(renewal_q) < fq_rank(poc_q), "Renewal before POC ends",
  ifelse(fq_rank(renewal_q) == fq_rank(poc_q), "Renewal in the POC quarter", "Renewal after POC ends")))))
# ── OBO revenue target, forecast into the PoV completion quarter ──────────
# Target = OBO revenue needed to hold ARR after seat rework + open agentic
# pipeline + expansion_pct x ARR. It lands in poc_q.
poc$pipeline0     <- ifelse(is.na(poc$agentic_pipeline), 0, poc$agentic_pipeline)
poc$expansion_tgt <- poc$arr * params$expansion_pct
poc$obo_tgt       <- ifelse(is.na(poc$obo_needed), 0, poc$obo_needed) + poc$pipeline0 + ifelse(is.na(poc$expansion_tgt), 0, poc$expansion_tgt)
poc <- poc[order(-poc$arr), ]

fc <- poc %>% mutate(Quarter = ifelse(is.na(poc_q), "No date", fq_show(poc_q))) %>%
  group_by(Quarter) %>%
  summarise(rank = if (all(is.na(poc_q))) Inf else min(fq_rank(poc_q)), Accounts = n(),
            accts = and_list(account), ARR = sum(arr, na.rm = TRUE),
            rework = sum(obo_needed, na.rm = TRUE), pipeline = sum(pipeline0), expansion = sum(expansion_tgt, na.rm = TRUE),
            licensed = sum(licensed, na.rm = TRUE), elas = sum(ela), registered = sum(registered, na.rm = TRUE),
            queries = if (all(is.na(query_volume))) NA_real_ else sum(query_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
            tgt = sum(obo_tgt), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(rank) %>% mutate(cum = cumsum(tgt))
tot_tgt <- sum(poc$obo_tgt)

low_poc <- poc[poc$low, ]
tot_arr <- sum(poc$arr, na.rm = TRUE)
```
## Assertion

**Assertion:** If a customer has low consumption, we will not be able to drive a session-based expansion and will need to rework an existing contract and sacrifice growth in order to quantify session-based revenue.

The following study uses all `r nrow(poc)` OBO revenue target accounts, every customer with an agentic PoV
(`r and_list(poc$account)`), and tests the assertion against their consumption, product adoption rating and ARR,
with every other customer as the backdrop. Each account's OBO revenue target is then forecast into the fiscal
quarter its PoV is expected to complete.

## Summary

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
bullets <- c(
  sprintf("**%d OBO revenue target accounts, %s ARR** (%s of the %s book).", nrow(poc), usd(tot_arr),
          pct(tot_arr / sum(book$arr, na.rm = TRUE), 1), usdk(sum(book$arr, na.rm = TRUE))),
  sprintf("**OBO revenue target: %s**, by PoV completion quarter: %s.", usd(tot_tgt),
          paste0(fc$Quarter, " ", usd(fc$tgt), collapse = ", ")),
  if (nrow(low_poc)) sprintf(
    "**%s of that ARR (%s) sits with low-consumption customers**: %s. Between them they pay for %s seats and have %s registered users (%s).",
    usd(sum(low_poc$arr)), pct(sum(low_poc$arr) / tot_arr),
    and_list(paste0(low_poc$account, " (", pct(low_poc$ratio, 1), " of seats used)")),
    int(sum(low_poc$licensed)), int(sum(low_poc$registered)), pct(sum(low_poc$registered) / sum(low_poc$licensed), 1)),
  if (nrow(low_poc)) sprintf(
    "**Rework exposure.** Right-sizing their seats to registered users × %s leaves %s of seat ARR; OBO sessions would have to cover the other **%s** just to hold them flat.",
    params$seat_buffer, usd(sum(low_poc$seat_arr, na.rm = TRUE)), usd(sum(low_poc$obo_needed, na.rm = TRUE))),
  if (any(!poc$low)) sprintf(
    "**%s** %s consuming at or above the low threshold (%s ARR), so OBO sessions there can be additive rather than a replacement for seat revenue.",
    and_list(paste0(poc$account[!poc$low], " (", pct(poc$ratio[!poc$low]), ifelse(poc$ela[!poc$low], ", ELA", ""), ")")),
    if (sum(!poc$low) == 1) "is" else "are", usd(sum(poc$arr[!poc$low]))),
  sprintf("**Timing.** %s.", paste0(poc$account, ": POC ", fq_show(poc$poc_q), ", contract ends ",
          fq_show(poc$renewal_q), " (", tolower(poc$timing), ")", collapse = "; ")),
  if (length(unmatched)) sprintf("*PoV projects / names with no account match: %s.*", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
)
cat(paste0("- ", bullets[nzchar(bullets)], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

## OBO Revenue Target Accounts

```{r cohort-table}
tab <- poc %>% transmute(
  Account = account, `PoV status` = ifelse(is.na(pov_status) | !nzchar(pov_status), "—", pov_status),
  `PoV ends` = paste0(ifelse(is.na(poc_end), "—", format(poc_end, "%b %d, %Y")), " (", fq_show(poc_q), ")"),
  ARR = usd(arr),
  `Seats used` = seats_used(ratio, licensed), Registered = int(registered),
  Licensed = ifelse(!is.na(licensed) & licensed == 0, "Unlimited", int(licensed)),
  `Active (31d)` = int(active31),
  `Product adoption` = paste0(ifelse(is.na(rating), "—", rating), ifelse(is.na(score), "", paste0(" (", score, ")"))),
  `Lifecycle` = lifecycle,
  `Agentic eval / deploy` = paste(ifelse(is.na(eval), "—", eval), ifelse(is.na(deploy), "—", deploy), sep = " / "),
  `OBO agent users` = int(obo_agents),
  `Agentic pipeline` = usd(agentic_pipeline))
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r"))
```

<small>PoV ends = earliest Expected End Date on the account's agentic PoV project(s) and its fiscal
quarter (an `obo_pocs.csv` estimate where the PoV has no date). Seats used = registered ÷ licensed users (`consumption_ratio()`); ELA = unlimited seats.
Active (31d) = users querying through a native platform integration in the last 31 days.
Product adoption = `product_adoption_rating` (score 0–12). OBO agent users = enabled agent
users across instances (Looker OBO look). Agentic pipeline = open expansions whose name mentions
Agentic / OBO.</small>

## Consumption against ARR, whole book

Every customer by seats used and ARR, coloured by product adoption rating; the OBO revenue target
accounts are labelled. Left of the dashed line is low consumption.

```{r scatter}
b <- book %>% filter(!is.na(ratio), !is.na(arr), arr > 0) %>%
  mutate(x = pmin(ratio, 1.5), col = ifelse(is.na(colour), "#9CA3AF", COL[colour]),
         hover = paste0("<b>", account, "</b><br>ARR ", usd(arr), "<br>Seats used ", seats_used(ratio, licensed),
                        " (", int(registered), " / ", ifelse(licensed == 0, "unlimited", int(licensed)), ")<br>",
                        ifelse(is.na(rating), "", rating)))
p_b <- b %>% filter(!is_poc); p_p <- b %>% filter(is_poc)
plot_ly() %>%
  add_markers(data = p_b, x = ~x, y = ~arr, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", name = "Other customers",
              marker = list(color = p_b$col, size = 9, opacity = 0.45, line = list(width = 0))) %>%
  add_markers(data = p_p, x = ~x, y = ~arr, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", name = "OBO revenue target",
              marker = list(color = p_p$col, size = 17, symbol = "diamond", line = list(color = "#111111", width = 1.5))) %>%
  add_text(data = p_p, x = ~x, y = ~arr, text = ~account, textposition = "top center", showlegend = FALSE,
           textfont = list(size = 12, color = "#111111"), hoverinfo = "none") %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Seats used (registered ÷ licensed, capped at 150%; ELAs count as 100%)", tickformat = ".0%"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Contract ARR", type = "log", tickformat = "$,.2s"),
         shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = params$low_threshold, x1 = params$low_threshold, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                            yref = "paper", line = list(dash = "dash", color = "#9CA3AF"))),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
```

```{r arr-by-band}
bb <- book %>% filter(!is.na(band)) %>% group_by(Consumption = band) %>%
  summarise(Customers = n(), ARR = sum(arr, na.rm = TRUE), `OBO targets` = sum(is_poc),
            `Target ARR` = sum(arr[is_poc], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(`Share of ARR` = pct(ARR / sum(ARR)), ARR = usd(ARR), `Target ARR` = usd(`Target ARR`))
knitr::kable(bb, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

## Contract Rework Candidates

With relative consumption as a value metric, the plot below depicts how much of a gap session-based revenue would have to mitigate to avoid downsell.   Alternatively, how difficult it would be to sell a session based expansion.

```{r rework-table}
rw <- poc %>% transmute(
  Account = account, ARR = usd(arr), `Licensed seats` = int(licensed), `Registered` = int(registered),
  `Unused seats` = int(unused), `Price / seat` = ifelse(ela, "ELA", usd(price_seat)),
  `Right-sized seats` = int(right_seats), `Seat ARR after` = usd(seat_arr),
  `OBO revenue to hold ARR` = usd(obo_needed), `Share of ARR` = pct(obo_needed / arr))
if (params$obo_price > 0) rw$`OBO sessions needed` <- int(poc$sessions)
knitr::kable(rw, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(rw) - 1)))
```

```{r rework-chart}
rc <- poc %>% filter(!is.na(seat_arr)) %>% mutate(account = factor(account, levels = rev(account)))
plot_ly(rc, y = ~account, x = ~seat_arr, type = "bar", orientation = "h", name = "Seat ARR after right-sizing",
        marker = list(color = "#9CA3AF"), hovertemplate = "%{y}: seats %{x:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  add_trace(x = ~obo_needed, name = "OBO revenue needed to hold ARR", marker = list(color = "#7C3AED"),
            hovertemplate = "%{y}: OBO %{x:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "Current ARR, split", tickformat = "$,.2s"),
         yaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25))
```

<small>Price per seat is blended: it includes platform and other fees, so treat the split as
an upper bound on what moves from seats to OBO. ELA accounts count as 100% consumption: no
seats to right-size, so all of their ARR stays as is and OBO sessions are pure expansion. Change `seat_buffer` (and `obo_price`, once there is one) in
the YAML header to re-run the scenario.</small>



## OBO Revenue Target Forecast

Each account's OBO revenue target lands in the fiscal quarter its agentic PoV is expected to complete
(the PoV's Expected End Date). The target is the OBO revenue needed to hold ARR after seat rework, plus
open agentic pipeline`r if (params$expansion_pct > 0) paste0(", plus a ", pct(params$expansion_pct), " of ARR session-based expansion") else ""`.

```{r forecast-chart}
fcp <- fc %>% mutate(Quarter = factor(Quarter, levels = Quarter))
p_fc <- plot_ly(fcp, x = ~Quarter, y = ~rework, type = "bar", name = "OBO revenue to hold ARR (rework)",
                marker = list(color = "#7C3AED"), text = ~accts,
                hovertemplate = "%{x}: rework %{y:$,.0f}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
  add_trace(y = ~pipeline, name = "Open agentic pipeline", marker = list(color = "#A8CC18"),
            hovertemplate = "%{x}: pipeline %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>")
if (params$expansion_pct > 0) p_fc <- p_fc %>%
  add_trace(y = ~expansion, name = paste0("Expansion (", pct(params$expansion_pct), " of ARR)"),
            marker = list(color = "#F59E0B"), hovertemplate = "%{x}: expansion %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>")
p_fc %>%
  add_trace(y = ~cum, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", name = "Cumulative target",
            line = list(color = "#111111"), marker = list(color = "#111111"),
            hovertemplate = "%{x}: cumulative %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "PoV completion quarter"),
         yaxis = list(title = "OBO revenue target", tickformat = "$,.2s"), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25))
```

```{r forecast-table}
ft <- fc %>% transmute(Quarter, Accounts = paste0(Accounts, ": ", accts), ARR = usd(ARR),
                       `Licensed users` = paste0(int(licensed), ifelse(elas > 0, paste0(" + ", elas, " ELA"), "")),
                       `Query volume` = int(queries),
                       `OBO to hold ARR` = usd(rework), `Agentic pipeline` = usd(pipeline),
                       Expansion = usd(expansion), `OBO revenue TGT` = usd(tgt), Cumulative = usd(cum))
if (params$expansion_pct <= 0) ft$Expansion <- NULL
knitr::kable(ft, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", ncol(ft) - 2)))
```

```{r forecast-accounts}
fa <- poc %>% arrange(is.na(poc_q), fq_rank(poc_q), -obo_tgt) %>% transmute(
  Account = account, Quarter = fq_show(poc_q),
  `PoV ends` = ifelse(is.na(poc_end), "—", format(poc_end, "%b %d, %Y")), Source = poc_q_src,
  `Seats used` = seats_used(ratio, licensed), ARR = usd(arr),
  `Licensed users` = ifelse(ela, paste0("Unlimited (", int(registered), " registered)"), int(licensed)),
  `Query volume` = int(query_volume),
  `OBO to hold ARR` = usd(obo_needed), `Agentic pipeline` = usd(pipeline0),
  Expansion = usd(expansion_tgt), `OBO revenue TGT` = usd(obo_tgt))
if (params$expansion_pct <= 0) fa$Expansion <- NULL
knitr::kable(fa, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", rep("r", ncol(fa) - 4)))
```

<small>Licensed users and query volume are proxies for OBO session volume: how many people an
agent could act on behalf of, and how much data access already runs through Immuta. Licensed users
are the contracted seats (an ELA has unlimited seats, so registered users stand in); query volume is
queries on Production instances from Looker look 1745 (RAW DATA - QUERIES, the latest 31 days where
the look is dated). Query volume shows as — until the next `main.R` run stores it in the snapshot.

Accounts with a $0 target have no rework gap (seats used at or above the low threshold, or an
ELA) and no open agentic pipeline: the session-based expansion there is still unsized. Set
`expansion_pct` in the YAML header to give every account an expansion target as a share of its ARR.</small>

## Method and data

- Data: the `r snap_date` op_list snapshot (`r basename(snap)`): `accounts` (ARR, product adoption
  rating, lifecycle, Agentic Governance Adoption), `consumption$low_consumption` (registered and
  licensed users, native-query users), `consumption$obo_sessions` (OBO agent users and vended
  roles), `agentic_profile` (conversation / evaluation / deployment status), `renewals` (next
  contract end) and `expansions` (open agentic pipeline).
- Cohort: `r cohort_src`. PoV completion = earliest Expected End Date on the account's agentic PoV
  project(s) (`agentic_pov`), as a fiscal quarter; where a PoV has no date, the estimate in
  `r params$poc_file`. FY28-Q1 is Q1-2028 in the package's fiscal labels (Feb–Apr 2027).
- OBO revenue target = OBO revenue to hold ARR (rework, below) + open agentic pipeline (expansions
  named Agentic / OBO) + `expansion_pct` × ARR (`r pct(params$expansion_pct)`), forecast into the PoV
  completion quarter.
- Rework scenario: price per seat = ARR ÷ licensed seats; right-sized seats = registered ×
  `r params$seat_buffer` (capped at today's seats); OBO revenue to hold ARR = ARR − right-sized
  seats × price per seat. ELA accounts (0 licensed seats) count as 100% consumption, per company
  strategy to drive session-based expansion there: nothing to rework, OBO revenue needed = $0.
- `r nrow(poc)` OBO target accounts are a case study, not a sample: read the cohort tables as account plans,
  and the whole-book consumption chart for how they sit against every other customer.
